description: Create/delete a volume in Packet host.

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Packet API token. You can also supply it in environment variable PACKET_API_TOKEN.

parameters.name: billing_cycle
parameters.description: Billing cycle for new volume. Choices: "hourly" ← (default) "monthly"

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: User-defined description attribute for Packet volume. It is used used as idempotent identifier - if volume with given description exists, new one is not created.

parameters.name: facility
parameters.description: Location of the volume. Volumes can only be attached to device in the same location.

parameters.name: locked
parameters.description: Create new volume locked. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Selector for API-generated name of the volume.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.description: storage_1 for standard tier, storage_2 for premium (performance) tier. Tiers are described at https://www.packet.com/cloud/storage/. Choices: "storage_1" ← (default) "storage_2"

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: ID of project of the device.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the volume in gigabytes.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Desired state of the volume. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

examples:
# All the examples assume that you have your Packet API token in env var PACKET_API_TOKEN.
# You can also pass the api token in module param auth_token.

- hosts: localhost
  vars:
    volname: testvol123
    project_id: 53000fb2-ee46-4673-93a8-de2c2bdba33b

  tasks:
    - name: Create volume
      community.general.packet_volume:
        description: "{{ volname }}"
        project_id: "{{ project_id }}"
        facility: 'ewr1'
        plan: 'storage_1'
        state: present
        size: 10
        snapshot_policy:
          snapshot_count: 10
          snapshot_frequency: 1day
      register: result_create

    - name: Delete volume
      community.general.packet_volume:
        id: "{{ result_create.id }}"
        project_id: "{{ project_id }}"
        state: absent

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: The user-defined description of the volume resource. Returned: success Sample: "Just another volume"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: UUID of specified volume. Returned: success Sample: "53000fb2-ee46-4673-93a8-de2c2bdba33c"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The API-generated name of the volume resource. Returned: if volume is attached/detached to/from some device Sample: "volume-a91dc506"
